intro.data: The Unit type holds exactly ONE value — a single point. From any data, there's exactly one way to map into it: forget everything and land on that point. One machine does that honest collapse; the other tries to keep the record's details, but the one-point Unit has nowhere to put them, so it jams. Build the collapse.
intro.alchemy: The Residue is a single inert speck — one point. From any material, there's exactly one way to reach it: reduce everything to that speck. One apparatus does the honest reduction; the other tries to preserve the material, but the speck has nowhere to hold it, so it jams. Build the reduction.
intro.spellcraft: The Null is a single still point. From any essence, there's exactly one way to reach it: let everything settle to that point. One rune does the honest settling; the other tries to keep the essence, but the still point has nowhere to hold it, so it jams. Build the settling.
intro.abstract: 1 is terminal: from every object there is exactly one morphism A → 1, collapsing all structure to the single point. Build that unique map; a map that tries to retain information cannot exist (it jams).

goal.data: Collapse any record to the single point of the Unit.
goal.alchemy: Reduce any material to the single speck of Residue.
goal.spellcraft: Settle any essence to the single point of Null.

afterSuccess.data: The record collapsed to the single point of the Unit — and that's the ONLY thing a map into a one-point type can do. That's what makes Unit terminal: from every type there's exactly one arrow into it. 'Hold On' tried to keep information the one point can't hold, so it had no honest behavior.
afterSuccess.alchemy: The material reduced to the single speck — the only thing a map into a one-point residue can do. That's what makes it terminal: exactly one arrow in from everything.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: The essence settled to the single point — the only thing a map into a one-point null can do. That's what makes it terminal: exactly one arrow in from everything.
afterSuccess.abstract: A → 1 is forced: with one point in the target, only one function exists. That uniqueness from EVERY object is the universal property of the terminal object — the simplest limit.

reveal.summary: A terminal object 1 has exactly one morphism A → 1 from every object — everything collapses to its single point. It is the limit of the empty diagram; its dual (one arrow out to everything) is the initial object.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: Unit / void (): exactly one value, so exactly one function A => ().
